question: What is the value of (2)/(7) × [2 + {2 (11 + 4 - 2)}] - 2
solution:
**Given:**

What is the value of (2)/(7) × [2 + {2 (11 + 4 - 2)}] - 2

**Formula used:**

BODMAS (Brackets, Orders (i.e. powers and square roots, etc.), Division and Multiplication, Addition and Subtraction)

**Calculation:**

(2)/(7) × [2 + {2 (11 + 4 - 2)}] - 2

⇒ (2)/(7) × [2 + {2 (13)}] - 2

⇒ (2)/(7) × [2 + 26] - 2

⇒ (2)/(7) × 28 - 2

⇒ 8 - 2

⇒ 6

**∴ The correct answer is option 1.**
